verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a password manager, so the axis applies. The evidence shows a CLI that can retrieve secrets in scripts and CI/CD pipelines, which is only a developer building block. It also shows Pass Monitor, which scans for leaks and sends reminders, but that is a built-in feature, not user-defined rules that trigger actions on events. Nothing in the pack documents a rule or trigger engine.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
